Yona frɛ ne n’asoɔden
1 # 2 Ah 14.25 Na AWURADE asɛm baa Amitai ba Yona nkyɛn sɛ: 2Sɔre kɔ Ninewe kuro kɛseɛ no mu, na pae mu ma wɔnhu sɛ wɔn bɔne aforo aba m’anim. 3#Dwom 139.7, 9-10 Ɛnna Yona sɔree sɛ ɔredwane akɔ Tarsis afiri AWURADE anim, na ɔsiane kɔɔ Yopa, na ɔkɔhunuu ɛhyɛn bi a ɛrekɔ Tarsis; na ɔtuaa ka kɔtenaa mu sɛ ɔredwane AWURADE anim ne wɔn akɔ Tarsis. 4Na AWURADE maa mframa a ano yɛ den bɛbɔe wɔ ɛpo no so, na ahum kɛseɛ tui wɔ ɛpo no so, na ɛhyɛn no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ ɛrebɛbɔ.
Yona frɛ ne n’asoɔden
5Na ɛhyɛn no mufoɔ no suroe, na wɔteateaa mu frɛfrɛɛ wɔn anyame, na wɔtotoo ɛhyɛn no mu adwadeɛ guguu po mu na ayɛ hare ama wɔn; nso Yona deɛ, na wasiane kɔ ɛhyɛn no yam akɔda hatee. 6Ɛnna ɛhyɛn mu panin no kɔɔ Yona nkyɛn, na ɔbisaa no sɛ: Worepɛ akyerɛ sɛn nti a wada hatee saa yi? Sɔre su frɛ wo nyame, sɛ ebia ɔbɛdwene yɛn ho na yɛantotɔ wɔ ha.
7 # Mmb 16.33 Na wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Mommra mma yɛntwe ntonto mfa nhunu deɛ ne nti saa amaneɛ yi aba yɛn soɔ yi. Na wɔtwee ntonto no, ntonto no bɔɔ Yona. 8Ɛnna wɔsrɛɛ Yona sɛ: Kyerɛ yɛn deɛ ne nti saa amaneɛ yi aba yɛn soɔ yi? W’adwuma ne sɛn, na ɛhe na wofiri baeɛ? Wofiri ɔman bɛn mu, wo nkyi ne he? 9#Gye 1.9-10 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Meyɛ Hebrini, na mesɔre AWURADE, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ ɛpo ne asase pɛsɛɛ no. 10Ɛnna nnipa no suroo pii pa ara, na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yi? Na na nnipa no nim sɛ AWURADE anim na ɔredwane afire, ɛfiri sɛ na waka akyerɛ wɔn.
11Na wɔbisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ woɔ, na ɛpo no ano nnwo mma yɛn? Ɛfiri sɛ, na ɛpo no gu so ara rehuru. 12Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfa me na monto me ntwene ɛpo no mu, na ɛpo no bɛdwo ama mo; na menim sɛ me nti na ahum kɛseɛ yi aba mo soɔ yi.
Yona asotwe
13Nanso nnipa no bɔɔ mmɔden biara sɛ wɔresane aba asase pɛsɛɛ so, na wɔantumi, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛpo no gu so rehuru hyia wɔn ara. 14Ɛnna wɔsu frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: O AWURADE, onipa yi kra nti mma yɛntotɔ, na mfa mogya a yɛdi ho bem ngu yɛn so, na wo, AWURADE, na woyɛ sɛdeɛ wopɛ. 15Ɛnna wɔmaa Yona so too no twenee ɛpo no mu, na ɛpo no gyaee ne bagyabagyayɛ no. 16Na nnipa no suroo AWURADE pii pa ara, na wɔbobɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa AWURADE, na wɔhyehyɛɛ no bɔ.
17 # Mat 12.40; 16.4 Nso na AWURADE asiesie apataa kɛseɛ bi sɛ ɔmmene Yona. Na Yona dii apataa no yam nnansa awia ne anadwo.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa Amitai ba Yona nkyɛn sɛ: Sɔre kɔ Ninewe kuro kɛseɛ no mu, na pae mu ma wɔnhu sɛ wɔn bɔne aforo aba m’anim. Ɛnna Yona sɔree sɛ ɔredwane akɔ Tarsis afiri AWURADE anim, na ɔsiane kɔɔ Yopa, na ɔkɔhunuu ɛhyɛn bi a ɛrekɔ Tarsis; na ɔtuaa ka kɔtenaa mu sɛ ɔredwane AWURADE anim ne wɔn akɔ Tarsis. Na AWURADE maa mframa a ano yɛ den bɛbɔe wɔ ɛpo no so, na ahum kɛseɛ tui wɔ ɛpo no so, na ɛhyɛn no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ ɛrebɛbɔ.

Na ɛhyɛn no mufoɔ no suroe, na wɔteateaa mu frɛfrɛɛ wɔn anyame, na wɔtotoo ɛhyɛn no mu adwadeɛ guguu po mu na ayɛ hare ama wɔn; nso Yona deɛ, na wasiane kɔ ɛhyɛn no yam akɔda hatee. Na wɔsesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Mommra mma yɛntwe ntonto mfa nhunu deɛ ne nti saa amaneɛ yi aba yɛn soɔ yi. Na wɔtwee ntonto no, ntonto no bɔɔ Yona. Ɛnna wɔsrɛɛ Yona sɛ: Kyerɛ yɛn deɛ ne nti saa amaneɛ yi aba yɛn soɔ yi? W’adwuma ne sɛn, na ɛhe na wofiri baeɛ? Wofiri ɔman bɛn mu, wo nkyi ne he? Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Meyɛ Hebrini, na mesɔre AWURADE, ɔsoro Nyankopɔn a ɔyɛɛ ɛpo ne asase pɛsɛɛ no. Ɛnna nnipa no suroo pii pa ara, na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woayɛ yi? Na na nnipa no nim sɛ AWURADE anim na ɔredwane afire, ɛfiri sɛ na waka akyerɛ wɔn.
Na wɔbisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ woɔ, na ɛpo no ano nnwo mma yɛn? Ɛfiri sɛ, na ɛpo no gu so ara rehuru. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfa me na monto me ntwene ɛpo no mu, na ɛpo no bɛdwo ama mo; na menim sɛ me nti na ahum kɛseɛ yi aba mo soɔ yi.

Nanso nnipa no bɔɔ mmɔden biara sɛ wɔresane aba asase pɛsɛɛ so, na wɔantumi, ɛfiri sɛ na ɛpo no gu so rehuru hyia wɔn ara. Ɛnna wɔsu frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: O AWURADE, onipa yi kra nti mma yɛntotɔ, na mfa mogya a yɛdi ho bem ngu yɛn so, na wo, AWURADE, na woyɛ sɛdeɛ wopɛ. Ɛnna wɔmaa Yona so too no twenee ɛpo no mu, na ɛpo no gyaee ne bagyabagyayɛ no. Na nnipa no suroo AWURADE pii pa ara, na wɔbobɔɔ afɔdeɛ maa AWURADE, na wɔhyehyɛɛ no bɔ.
Nso na AWURADE asiesie apataa kɛseɛ bi sɛ ɔmmene Yona. Na Yona dii apataa no yam nnansa awia ne anadwo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
